messages:
ana: Heads-up: sample-app in monorepo fails when importing core via pnpm workspace symlink in edge dev. error looks like exports resolution + missing typings.
ana: repro: pnpm -w install && pnpm -w build && pnpm --filter sample dev:edge
ana: runtime: Error: Cannot find module 'core-lib/esm'
ryan: Seen that. Common causes: incomplete `exports` map, missing "types" in package.json, or bundler following realpath for symlinks. Edge bundlers + pnpm symlinks are a messy combo.
kai: Quick checklist: 1) add both import/require keys in exports, 2) export "./package.json", 3) include types in dist and set "types": "dist/index.d.ts" so TS consumers resolve correctly.
ryan: Also watch for declarationMap and sourceRoot in tsconfig/build. declarationMap can leak workspace absolute paths which confuse sourcemap mapping in edge. Turn it off for packages shipped as artifacts.
nana: Workaround I used: change sample dev imports to point to file:../packages/core-lib/dist/esm during local edge dev. Ugly but reliable.
dev-bot: CI alert: apps/sample-edge failed to start: Cannot find module 'core-lib/esm' (job 301). Logs attached.
kai: Another angle: nodeLinker=node-modules (hoisted) removes symlinks and sometimes avoids the issue, but not everyone can switch. Also Node 20 enforces exports more strictly than 18. Document supported node versions.
ryan: For esbuild plugin, prefer resolving symlinked packages to their package root: if (isWorkspacePkg(id)) resolveTo(path.join(repoRoot, pkgDir, 'dist/esm/index.js')) — stops realpath->consumer dist path.
kai: We'll add a short note to the sample README and file an issue to change dev server resolver behaviour. Include minimal repro and the CI log.
nana: Thanks. I'll push READMEs + issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/220 (draft).
